claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Sulfinpyrazone is a uricosuric organic-anion transport inhibitor and weak cyclooxygenase inhibitor that is unlikely to kill cancer cells at 2.5 uM; any modest antiproliferative effect would reflect organic-anion transport inhibition or nonspecific cyclooxygenase inhibition rather than a cytotoxic mechanism.
